text: Are half duplex. They cannot transmit and receive at the same time. They are very simple nodes, with only one transceiver, and therefore, after having received this data packet, the sing will turn around its transceiver from receive mode to transmit mode and then transmit the ACK. The peculiarity is that since these are very simple devices, okay, less sophisticated than Wi-Fi cards, much less sophisticated, they take much longer to perform this turnaround of the transceiver. So as we will see from numerical examples, this seems is now, for example, 192 microseconds, okay. It was 10 microseconds in the, sorry, it was 20 microseconds in Wi-Fi. So you can see that is much much longer. And the last thing that I will like to mention is that after that the sing has transmitted an acknowledgement, it will be able to receive signals only after SIFS. Because again, here it is transmitting, right? If we want the sing be able to receive something else, we have to wait again for this SIFS because it has again to turn around its transceiver from receive mode, sorry, transmit mode, where it transmits the ACK.
